summary: The mobile layout exhibits overlay positioning defects where floating menus and tooltips obscure critical page content and trigger anchors.

issues.title: Misplaced anchor and content obstruction
issues.description: The tooltip obscures descriptive text and its pointer does not align with the info trigger icon.
issues.evidence: Tooltip box covers card body copy while the arrow points downward away from the top-right info icon.
issues.suggestion: Reposition tooltip relative to the info trigger or present context inline on small screens.

issues.title: Viewport edge collision and content obscuration
issues.description: Dropdown overlays section headers and touches the right screen boundary.
issues.evidence: Menu obscures 'Alert filt' and 'Choose whi' headings and hugs the right viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Add boundary padding and constrain menu position relative to its activator.
